detail_about_body_mission: KoruBeni is an emergency platform designed to strengthen personal safety. Our goal is to help you take quick action in critical moments and reach your safety network with a single touch.
detail_about_body_features:
• Panic Button: Start an emergency call by holding
• Emergency Contacts: Save up to 5 emergency contacts
• Location Sharing: Real-time location sharing
• Fake Call: Fake call simulation for your safety
• Siren: Loud alarm
• Quick Message: Send emergency messages with one touch
• Safe Walk: Timed safety check
detail_about_body_disclaimer: This app is a supportive tool in emergencies. Operator/institution response times and communication infrastructure are outside the app's control. In real danger, it is recommended to call 112, 155 or 110 directly.
detail_privacy_body_1: At KoruBeni, we value your privacy. This policy explains the personal data collected, used, and protected when you use our app. By using the app, you accept this policy.
detail_privacy_body_2:
• Phone Number: For login via Firebase Authentication
• Location Data: For sharing in emergencies (with permission)
• Emergency Contact Info: Stored securely on device
• PIN Code: Encrypted and stored on device, never sent to servers
• Activity History: Local log of your in-app actions
• Device Info: For crash reports (Firebase Crashlytics)
detail_privacy_body_3:
Location data is used only in the following cases:
• Location sharing when emergency button is pressed
• When user activates location sharing
• Showing current location in map view

Location data is not collected in the background. You can turn off location sharing in settings anytime.
detail_privacy_body_4:
• Sensitive data (PIN, emergency contacts) protected with AES encryption
• Data stored in device's secure storage (iOS Keychain / Android Keystore)
• Firebase communication encrypted with SSL/TLS
• Inactive server-side data is cleaned regularly
detail_privacy_body_5:
The app uses the following third-party services:
• Firebase Authentication: User authentication
• Firebase Firestore: Emergency records
• Firebase Crashlytics: App crash reports
• Firebase Analytics: Anonymous usage statistics
• Firebase Cloud Messaging: Notifications

Refer to Google's privacy policy for these services' privacy policies.
detail_privacy_body_6:
• Local data: All local data is deleted when you uninstall the app
• Server data: Server data is deleted within 30 days when you delete your account
• Activity history: Stored only on device, maximum 50 records
• Session data is deleted immediately when you log out
detail_privacy_body_7:
You have the following rights:
• Request access to your data
• Request correction of your data
• Request deletion of your data
• Object to data processing

{rights_contact}
detail_help_body_howto:
1. Select Emergency Contact: Add trusted contacts from the Contacts tab
2. Set PIN: Automatically prompted on first login
3. Grant Permissions: Enable location and contacts permissions
4. Panic Button: Hold the button on the home page, countdown starts after release
5. Cancel with PIN: Enter PIN within 10 seconds for false alarms
detail_help_body_faq:
Q: I forgot my PIN, what should I do?
A: Log out and log in again, you will be asked to create a new PIN.

Q: Does location sharing drain battery?
A: No, location is only used when actively sharing. It doesn't run in the background.

Q: Does the fake call look real?
A: Yes, it looks like a real call screen. You can enter any name and number.

Q: Do my emergency contacts get notified?
A: When panic button is triggered, SMS is sent to your emergency contacts and the primary contact is called.
